component.name: Kakiri
component.summary: Play sounds through a virtual microphone in Discord

description.p: Kakiri is a soundboard that mixes sound effects and music into a virtual microphone, so Discord (or any other voice app) hears them as your voice. Your real microphone is mixed in as well, so you can keep talking.

ul.li: Library of folders with search, tags and cover art
Hotkey pads for firing sounds mid-call
Timeline arranger that layers clips on six tracks, editable while it plays
Import by dropping a file, pasting a direct link, or downloading a video's audio
Windows-neutral design: soundboard goes to the virtual mic, preview stays on your headphones

description.p: First public build: library, hotkey pads, timeline arranger, importing files/videos/links, and a persistent virtual microphone on PipeWire.
